description: This file contains the implementation of the StorageBackend class, which provides operations for synchronizing notes with a file storage backend using Android's DocumentFile API. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving notes, as well as validating configuration and handling file I/O.

classes.name: StorageBackend
classes.description: A class that manages synchronization of notes with a file storage backend using Android's DocumentFile API, implementing create, read, update, delete operations, and configuration validation.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the storage backend is accessible and has the necessary permissions.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note file in the storage backend with the specified note content.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note file in the storage backend based on the provided IdMapping.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the note file specified by the IdMapping from the storage backend.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a note from the storage backend based on the provided IdMapping.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all note files available in the storage backend.

methods.name: validateConfig
methods.description: Validates the configuration for accessing the storage backend.

search-terms: sync notes with Android file system
